label: professor or university teacher at

scope_notes: The dominant professor/teach paths define an academic teaching affiliation. Expert, specialist, dean, researcher or analyst alone need not imply a professorship or teaching role. Explicit professor/teaches evidence supports a mixed case; a location or attendance alone does not.
